description: Functions that agents can call. Your own tools are checked and run in a sandbox.
sandboxNote: Sandbox for testing and running your own tools: {{sandbox}} (can be changed in the settings).

trustNote.user-authored: Written by you: runs in a separate Python process without isolation on this computer.
trustNote.untrusted: AI-created or of unknown origin: runs only isolated, here in the Docker sandbox.
trustNote.untrustedBlocked: AI-created or of unknown origin: runs only isolated, but neither the built-in Linux sandbox nor Docker is available. Agents with this tool cannot run; see Settings → Sandbox.
trustNote.untrustedBuiltin: AI-created or of unknown origin: runs only isolated, here in the built-in Linux sandbox (no network, no access to your files or keys). This stays so after your approval.

delete: Delete tool: withdraws it; agents with this tool cannot start again until you remove it from them
tryHint: Calls the tool with this input, as an agent would.

write.intro: Write a Python function with types and a docstring. Name, description and input schema are derived from it. Tests are test_* functions that call the function. On saving, everything is checked statically and the tests run in the sandbox. Write code, names and docstrings in English: agents read them in every language.

generate.question: What should the tool be able to do?
generate.hint: A Coding Agent writes code and tests. Both are checked statically, the tests run in the sandbox. Then you decide whether the tool is added.
generate.placeholder: e.g. Calculate the annuity of a loan from amount, annual interest rate in percent and term in months.
generate.reviewNote: Review code and tests before approving the tool. Approved tools can be used by all agents.
generate.dependenciesNote: The proposal uses third-party libraries. Nothing is installed; the tests only run after your approval. You approve the code separately afterwards.
generate.needsDocker: Creating tools with AI needs isolation: the tests of AI-written code never run without it. The built-in Linux sandbox is not available here (see Settings → Sandbox); choose Docker instead.

drafts.label: Tool drafts
drafts.text: The Workflow Architect wrote these tools. They are not registered and have not run. Agents that need them cannot start until you approve them.

sandboxBuiltin: separate Python process; AI-created tools in the built-in Linux sandbox
